# collection kind

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:collectionKind`](gmeow-collectionKind.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/collectionKind>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

The kind of pitch collection (scale, mode, maqam, raga, pitch-class set, etc.). Functional: a [`PitchCollection`](../classes/gmeow-PitchCollection.md) is of exactly one kind; hybrid or contested categorisations are modelled as coexisting standpoints ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
